# Nordic Tracker Changelog

## [1.4.0] - 2026-09-29

Biometric Face ID authentication, offline GPS route caching, and interactive Apple Watch complications.

### Added
- Biometric Face ID and fingerprint quick unlock for instant workout tracking
- Offline GPS Route Caching: record trails without cellular network connectivity
- Interactive lock screen and watchOS glanceable complications

### Changed
- Optimized background GPS sampling to reduce device battery drain by 35%
- Upgraded map vector tiles to high-resolution topographic rendering

### Fixed
- Fixed crash on iOS 18 when importing GPX files with missing altitude tags
- Resolved Bluetooth heart-rate sensor auto-reconnect delay

https://nordictracker.app/releases/1-4-0
